name: Rego Interactive Co., Ltd
summary: Rego Interactive Co., Ltd, an investment holding company, provides marketing and promotion, IT solutions, and other services in Mainland China. It operates in two segments, Corporate Digitalisation Solutions Services and Industry Digitalisation Solutions Services. The company provides promotion and advertising services, including traditional marketing and promotion; advertisement placement; advertisement distribution services; and virtual and tangible goods sourcing and delivery services. It also offers software development and maintenance services; and solutions on lottery-related software systems and equipment.
